note: Site lists only 'Doble Cinco' (5x50). Mac photos were originally filed under shorthand names that dropped the 'Doble' prefix and, in one case, used the wrong word entirely ('Divine' instead of the real 'Divine Inspiration'). Research confirmed the real official names/sizes below and I renamed the Mac photo files to match. Casa Cuba is a revived historic Ybor City brand (originally Maseda family, acquired by Fuente in the late 1970s), relaunched in 2013 with an original blend by Carlos Fuente Sr. - it is deliberately not badged 'Arturo Fuente' on the box itself, though it's a Fuente product.
